definition: a person whose job is to drive a bus
exampleSentence: The bus driver was very friendly.
exampleTranslation: Tài xế xe buýt rất thân thiện.

definition: an open area where you can leave your car
exampleSentence: I'll meet you in the parking lot.
exampleTranslation: Mình gặp bạn ở bãi đỗ xe nhé.

definition: the numbers you press to call a phone
exampleSentence: Can I have your phone number?
exampleTranslation: Cho tôi xin số điện thoại của bạn được không?

definition: a statement of how much you must pay for phone calls
exampleSentence: My phone bill is high this month.
exampleTranslation: Tháng này hóa đơn điện thoại của tôi cao.

definition: a short written message sent from a phone
exampleSentence: I got a text message from my sister.
exampleTranslation: Tôi nhận được một tin nhắn từ chị gái.

definition: the letters and signs you use to send an email to someone
exampleSentence: What's your email address?
exampleTranslation: Địa chỉ email của bạn là gì?

definition: a small restaurant that serves coffee and snacks
exampleSentence: We met at a coffee shop.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi gặp nhau ở một quán cà phê.

definition: a large building with many shops inside
exampleSentence: The new shopping mall opens next month.
exampleTranslation: Trung tâm mua sắm mới sẽ khai trương vào tháng sau.

definition: a large container of water for swimming
exampleSentence: Our hotel has a big swimming pool.
exampleTranslation: Khách sạn của chúng tôi có một bể bơi lớn.

definition: the room in a house where people sit and relax
exampleSentence: We watched TV in the living room.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi xem ti vi trong phòng khách.

definition: the room in a house where people eat meals
exampleSentence: Dinner is served in the dining room.
exampleTranslation: Bữa tối được dọn trong phòng ăn.

definition: a machine for washing clothes
exampleSentence: The washing machine is broken.
exampleTranslation: Máy giặt bị hỏng rồi.

definition: a clock that makes a noise to wake you up
exampleSentence: My alarm clock rings at six.
exampleTranslation: Đồng hồ báo thức của tôi reo lúc sáu giờ.

definition: the main door at the front of a house
exampleSentence: Someone is knocking at the front door.
exampleTranslation: Có ai đó đang gõ cửa chính.

definition: a party to celebrate someone's birthday
exampleSentence: We are having a birthday party for her.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đang tổ chức tiệc sinh nhật cho cô ấy.

definition: a cake that you eat to celebrate a birthday
exampleSentence: She blew out the candles on her birthday cake.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy thổi nến trên chiếc bánh sinh nhật.

definition: the dress a woman wears at her wedding
exampleSentence: Her wedding dress was white and simple.
exampleTranslation: Váy cưới của cô ấy màu trắng và đơn giản.

definition: the time in the middle of the day when you stop work to eat
exampleSentence: I usually go for a walk during my lunch break.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thường đi dạo vào giờ nghỉ trưa.

definition: a social event where guests eat dinner at someone's home
exampleSentence: They invited us to a dinner party.
exampleTranslation: Họ mời chúng tôi đến một bữa tiệc tối.

definition: a story that you read to a child before they go to sleep
exampleSentence: He reads his son a bedtime story every night.
exampleTranslation: Mỗi tối anh ấy đọc truyện cho con trai trước khi ngủ.

definition: a set of red, yellow and green lights that controls traffic
exampleSentence: Turn right at the traffic light.
exampleTranslation: Rẽ phải ở chỗ đèn giao thông.

definition: a sign by the road that gives information to drivers
exampleSentence: Read the road sign carefully.
exampleTranslation: Hãy đọc kỹ biển báo giao thông.

definition: a crash involving a car
exampleSentence: He was injured in a car accident.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy bị thương trong một vụ tai nạn ô tô.

definition: a device that makes a loud noise when it senses smoke
exampleSentence: The smoke alarm went off in the kitchen.
exampleTranslation: Máy báo khói kêu trong bếp.

definition: websites and apps where people share content and talk to each other
exampleSentence: She spends a lot of time on social media.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy dành nhiều thời gian trên mạng xã hội.

definition: a report saying what the weather will be like
exampleSentence: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
exampleTranslation: Dự báo thời tiết nói ngày mai sẽ mưa.

definition: the help that a company gives to its customers
translation: dịch vụ khách hàng, chăm sóc khách hàng
exampleSentence: I called customer service about my order.
exampleTranslation: Tôi gọi chăm sóc khách hàng về đơn hàng của mình.

definition: the times when a place is open
exampleSentence: What are the opening hours of the museum?
exampleTranslation: Giờ mở cửa của bảo tàng là khi nào?

definition: to say strongly that something is very good
translation: rất khuyên dùng, rất giới thiệu
exampleSentence: I highly recommend this restaurant.
exampleTranslation: Tôi rất giới thiệu nhà hàng này.

definition: to agree completely with something
exampleSentence: I strongly agree with your opinion.
exampleTranslation: Tôi hoàn toàn đồng ý với ý kiến của bạn.

definition: knowing about something completely
exampleSentence: I'm fully aware of the problem.
exampleTranslation: Tôi hoàn toàn nhận thức được vấn đề.

definition: not like something else at all
exampleSentence: The two cities are completely different.
exampleTranslation: Hai thành phố này hoàn toàn khác nhau.

definition: harmed in a serious way
exampleSentence: The car was badly damaged.
exampleTranslation: Chiếc xe bị hư hại nặng.

definition: hurt in a way that is dangerous
exampleSentence: Two people were seriously injured.
exampleTranslation: Hai người bị thương nặng.

definition: very sorry
exampleSentence: I'm terribly sorry for the delay.
exampleTranslation: Tôi vô cùng xin lỗi vì sự chậm trễ.

definition: very important
exampleSentence: Sleep is extremely important for children.
exampleTranslation: Giấc ngủ cực kỳ quan trọng với trẻ em.

definition: completely usual and not strange
exampleSentence: It's perfectly normal to feel nervous.
exampleTranslation: Cảm thấy lo lắng là hoàn toàn bình thường.

definition: known by many people
exampleSentence: The singer is widely known in Asia.
exampleTranslation: Ca sĩ này được nhiều người biết đến ở châu Á.

definition: baked a short time ago
exampleSentence: I love the smell of freshly baked bread.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thích mùi bánh mì mới nướng.

definition: married and feeling happy
exampleSentence: They have been happily married for thirty years.
exampleTranslation: Họ đã có cuộc hôn nhân hạnh phúc suốt ba mươi năm.

definition: sleeping deeply
exampleSentence: The baby is fast asleep.
exampleTranslation: Em bé đang ngủ say.

definition: completely awake
exampleSentence: I was wide awake at three in the morning.
exampleTranslation: Ba giờ sáng tôi vẫn tỉnh như sáo.

definition: extremely cold
exampleSentence: It was a bitterly cold night.
exampleTranslation: Đó là một đêm lạnh buốt.

definition: extremely tired
exampleSentence: I was dead tired after the trip.
exampleTranslation: Sau chuyến đi tôi mệt rã rời.

definition: having no rooms or seats left
exampleSentence: The hotel is fully booked this weekend.
exampleTranslation: Cuối tuần này khách sạn kín phòng.

definition: feeling very thankful
exampleSentence: I am deeply grateful for your help.
exampleTranslation: Tôi vô cùng biết ơn sự giúp đỡ của bạn.

definition: extremely shy in a way that makes you uncomfortable
exampleSentence: He was painfully shy as a child.
exampleTranslation: Hồi nhỏ cậu ấy rụt rè đến khổ sở.

definition: easy to understand in every way
exampleSentence: Your instructions were perfectly clear.
exampleTranslation: Hướng dẫn của bạn hoàn toàn rõ ràng.

definition: extremely tasty
exampleSentence: The soup was absolutely delicious.
exampleTranslation: Món súp ngon tuyệt.

definition: to believe something very strongly
exampleSentence: I firmly believe that you can do it.
exampleTranslation: Tôi tin chắc rằng bạn làm được.
